panels.description: Source: server_version_num
panels.title: PostgreSQL Version

panels.description: Current replication lag in seconds. This is meaningful on a standby/replica and is typically zero on a primary.
panels.title: Max Replication Lag

panels.description:
Clients executing Statements.

panels.title: Active clients

panels.description: Ratio of shared-buffer hits to total block accesses across all databases on the selected exporter target. A higher ratio means more reads are served from PostgreSQL buffer cache.
panels.title: Shared Buffer Hits

panels.description: Fraction of configured max_connections currently in use across the selected PostgreSQL server.
panels.title: Connections used

panels.description: Fraction of completed transactions that ended in COMMIT rather than ROLLBACK across all databases on the selected server.
panels.title: Commit Ratio

panels.description: Setting: shared_buffers in PostgreSQL.conf
panels.title: Shared Buffers

panels.description: Total committed plus rolled-back transactions per second across all databases on the selected PostgreSQL server.
panels.title: Transaction rate

panels.description: Setting: max_connections in postgreSQL.conf
panels.title: Max Connections

panels.description: Replication lag and replay age over time for the selected PostgreSQL server. These metrics help indicate how far a replica trails its upstream.
panels.title: Replication Lag & Replay Age
